page.title: Contributing to MotoX Wiki
page.summary: How to add or update motorcycle specifications.
page.content:
How to Contribute

MotoX Wiki is community-maintained. You can contribute by:

  1. Forking the repository on GitHub
  2. Editing data/motorcycles.json, data/pages.json, or data/settings.json
  3. Running npm run build:data to regenerate indexes and detail files
  4. Committing changes and opening a pull request

Data Guidelines

  • Always cite the source (service manual, OEM documentation, manufacturer spec sheet)
  • Include year ranges and market/region when specs vary
  • Use standard units (Nm for torque, L for volume, hp/kW for power) with conversions in parentheses
  • Put general specs in sections.general_specs and service figures in sections.service
  • Leave a field out rather than filling it with a generic value — an empty field is better than wrong data
  • Mark unverified data in the notes field or a custom section
